thread:
Sam L: Quick async standup for AZ headroom/quotas — what I did / blockers / today

Sam L: Did: switched three prewarm pools in eu-west1 to dedicated-g5; observed ~10% tail latency improvement. Ran a quick traffic replay against staging.
Olivia P: Nice. Any eviction risk from spot pools after that change?
Sam L: No immediate evictions. I bumped fallback margin to 18% for those pools. Watching over next 2 hours.
Mike R: Blockers: We still have the quota request pending with cloud for asia-southeast1 GPUs. Ticket CLOUD-4937 is in review, but need an approval ETA. Anyone looped in on the contact side?
Darren H: I can nudge our cloud account rep — pinged them earlier this morning. Will follow up via email and paste reply here.
Rachel C: FYI: Ran a dry-run of the node-drain script and hit a race where the KV-cache warmup didn't rehydrate fast enough, causing a handful of timeouts in the replay.
Sam L: Thanks. Can you drop the snippet of the failing log?
Rachel C: Sure — pasted below:
```
[2026-02-03T09:12:04Z] WARN serving/runtime: KV cache miss for model redwood-v2-small seq=1024
[2026-02-03T09:12:04Z] ERROR serving/runtime: cold-start latency spike: 1.9s
```
Sam L: Looks like the warmup concurrency is set to 4. Increasing to 8 should help. I'm going to patch the helm values in staging: `helm upgrade --install prewarm --set warmup.concurrency=8 ./charts/prewarm`
Olivia P: Can you also add a small jitter to the warmup schedule? Last time they all triggered together and spiked backend.
Sam L: Yep adding jitter of up to 30s.
Mike R: Today: I'll follow up CLOUD-4937 and open an ops runbook for asia fallback to eu if quota is delayed. Will also open a tiny PR to add the jitter to the warmup job.
Darren H: If the cloud rep says no-go for the quota, we should enable a reduced-capacity lane (g4x2) for non-critical workloads and route critical pipelines to dedicated pools. I can draft policy.
InfraBot: Reminder: scheduled spot eviction drill in us-west2 at 2026-02-05T03:00Z — see #incidents for details :bell:
Rachel C: Quick ask: @Sam L can you eyeball my PR #2742? It's the prewarm concurrency change + log-level tweak. Small.
Sam L: On it, will review in 30m.
Olivia P: Also, for the quota request, include these two sentences in the justification: "We are transitioning production inference for vendor X to asia-southeast1 for lower p99 latency; request is to support reserved pools for dedicated capacity." That helped in previous approvals.
Mike R: Noted. I'll update CLOUD-4937.
Sam L: Last note: I'm onboarding a short-lived buffer of 12 cards for the weekend to handle expected spike. If anyone needs extra capacity, reply in-thread and I'll see if we can stretch or convert to reserved for the duration. :thumbsup:
Darren H: Thanks — I'll hold off any large-scale drains until the quota status is clear.
Olivia P: Thanks team — will monitor dashboards (per-route latency + token-cost) and flag regressions.
Sam L: End of sync.
